<!--
Global Ecosystem Classification 
-->


```{r typology_text, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Empty when typology wasn't requested (single consolidated "not requested"
# message lives in report_main.Rmd, and the parent suppresses the section
# header in that case too).

ecosystem_label <- if (is.na(params$ecosystem_name) || !nzchar(params$ecosystem_name)) {
  "ecosystem"
} else {
  params$ecosystem_name
}


if (is.null(params$typology)) {
  get_text <- ""
} else {
  get_text <- paste0(
    "To help the assessor identify the best match for the **", ecosystem_label, "** within the [IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology (GET)](https://global-ecosystems.org/), the most recent classification map (**", max(params$years), "**)  was overlayed on the global GET maps and the percentage cover of each ecosystem functional group (EFG), including both major and minor occurrences was calculated.  A summary of EFGs within the mapped ecosystem is presented in the table below with **'", params$typology[1,3], "'** the most prevalent major EFG. Any EFG with <1% occurrence coverage in the ecosystem is not displayed in this table.")
}
```

`r get_text`


```{r typology_table, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval = !is.null(params$typology)}
typology_df <- params$typology
title_text <- "Percentage of Global Ecosystem Typology across the ecosystem"

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
htmltools::tagList(
  # centered Title
  htmltools::div(
    style = "text-align:center; font-weight:bold; font-size:18px; margin-bottom:10px;", title_text),
  DT::datatable(typology_df, rownames=F,
                escape = FALSE,
                options = list(
                  pageLength = 5,
                  searching = FALSE,
                  info = FALSE,
                  #dom = 't',
                  autoWidth = TRUE,
                  scrollX = FALSE)) %>%
    DT::formatStyle(columns = c(1:ncol(typology_df)), fontSize = '100%')
)

}else{
    # flextable
  set_flextable_defaults(font.size = 10, theme_fun = theme_vanilla, padding = 5, background.color = "transparent")
  
  # get_tab <- flextable(typology_df) %>%
  #   set_caption(caption = as_paragraph(as_b(title_text))) %>%
  #   autofit() %>%
  #   flextable::theme_booktabs(bold_header = TRUE) %>%
  #   # colformat_num(j="Year", big.mark = "") %>%
  #   set_table_properties(layout="autofit")
  
  # get_tab <-   flextable(c) |>
  #   style_pdf_table(
  #     caption_text  = title_text,
  #     header_labels = list(
  #       `Ecosystem Functional Group` = "Ecosystem\nFunctional Group",
  #       `Major occurrence (%)`       = "Major\noccurrence (%)"
  #     )
  #   )
  # 
  # get_tab
  
# Create flextable with multi-line headers
get_tab <- flextable(typology_df) |>
  set_caption(
      caption = flextable::as_paragraph(flextable::as_b(title_text)),
      align_with_table = FALSE) |>   # let caption span page width, not just table
  set_header_labels(
        `Ecosystem Functional Group` = "Ecosystem\nFunctional\nGroup",
        `Major occurrence (%)`       = "Major\noccurrence\n(%)",
        `EFG_CODE` = "EFG\ncode",
        `Minor occurrence (%)`       = "Minor\noccurrence (%)"
  ) |>
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") |>
  align(align = "left", part = "all") |>  # Center header text
  valign(valign = "center", part = "all")# |> # Vertically center
  # autofit()  # Adjust column widths

get_tab
  
}
```
